framing: native vertical 9:16, picture fills the tall frame
style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, bright midday sunlight
character: shaggy cream goat with amber slit eyes and curled horns, a tax folder gripped in its teeth, fills two thirds of the frame
props: a bulging tax folder shedding forms; a boom microphone on a pole pushed at its muzzle; the reporter's hands and striped sleeve at the lens; a wooden fence rail it leans on until it breaks; a clipboard; a fresh stack of forms

motion_rule: the goat drives at the lens every window and never holds a pose; new shot size every window, camera always moving

audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 7.9
audio.lip_sync: jaw opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: paper tearing, fence rail cracking, teeth grinding on mic foam
